description:
Priority: P2 (layout/process). Files: scripts/init-service.sh, crates/client/ (-> crates/<service>-client/). Reference: keystore (keystore-client/), metricstore (metricstore-client/).

Problem: The directory is generically named crates/client/ while the package is __service_name__-client — mature siblings name the directory to match the package.

Change: Update init-service.sh to rename crates/client/ -> crates/<service-name>-client/ (and fix the members entry in Cargo.toml) during the __service_name__ substitution.

Acceptance: after init-service.sh, the client crate directory matches its package name and the workspace builds.
title: [TPL-020] Rename the generic client crate to the package-matched convention
